title: Ordinary coefficient evaluation preserves the single-square clopen arrow
statement: Let $R_n$ be arbitrary commutative rings with transition homomorphisms $\varphi_n:R_{n+1}\to R_n$. For a scheme $X$, let $\mathcal M_X$ be the actual semilinear module-system category of [def-sp-varying-ring-operations], and let $\mathcal T_X$ be the strict tower category with constant coefficient ring $R_n$ of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. Define $E_X:\mathcal M_X\to D(\mathcal T_X)$ by ordinary evaluation at $n$, constant strict-tower embedding, and the degree-zero embedding. There exist natural isomorphisms $g_f:f^*E_X\simeq E_YG_f$ for every $f:X\to Y$ and $j_i:i_!E_X\simeq E_UJ_i$ for every open immersion $i:U\to X$. They preserve the specified pullback and open-extension compositors. They also preserve the intrinsic single-square arrow of [def-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-arrows]: for every commutative square $k:V\to W$, $r:V\to S$, $p:W\to T$, $i:S\to T$ with $k,i$ quasi-compact open immersions, $r,p$ proper, and $kp=ri$, and every $N\in\mathcal M_S$, one has $E_W(a_{Q,N});j_{k,r^*N};J_k(g_{r,N})=g_{p,i_!N};G_p(j_{i,N});\alpha_{Q,E_SN}$, where $\alpha_Q$ is the arbitrary constant-$R_n$ strict-tower clopen arrow. Composition is written in order of application. No finiteness of $R_n$, cartesianness of the square, or faithfulness of evaluations on arbitrary derived morphisms is assumed.

proof.text: Choose the original specified ordinary pullback and open comparison isomorphisms. Their normalized pullback and open composition equations are precisely lem-sp-varying-ring-ordinary-comparison-normalization. This construction-normalization statement has no cartesian beta or clopen section arrow.

Factor moduleAlpha by its definition into cartesian moduleBeta followed by moduleSectionArrow. Use strictAlpha_factorization for the strict-tower arrow. Apply OrdinarySquareComparison.trans to the two comparison statements of the cartesian and section factors, using their identical intermediate pullback/open comparisons. Substitute the two factorizations and package these comparisons with the normalized pullback/open composition equations.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryClopenEvaluation (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (gIso : OrdinaryPullComparison R φ n) (jIso : OrdinaryOpenComparison R φ n),
      OrdinaryPullComposition R φ n gIso ∧ OrdinaryOpenComposition R φ n jIso ∧
        OrdinaryClopenComparison R φ n gIso jIso
